content: shadcn-svelte Sidebar: Provider (root state) > Root (variant: sidebar/floating/inset; collapsible: offcanvas/icon/none) > Header/Footer (sticky) > Content > Group > Menu > MenuItem > MenuButton (isActive prop for active state). Meaningfully more setup than a plain <nav>; token set (--sidebar-*) ships by default in shadcn-svelte init output regardless of whether the component itself is installed.
